text.en: Khalil Khodr is hereby granted Philippine citizenship with all the rights, privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto: Provided, That this grant shall become effective upon Khalil Khodr taking an oath of allegiance to the Republic of the Philippines and executing a renunciation of his former citizenship, copies of which shall be recorded in the civil registrar’s office in Butuan City: Provided, further, That the citizenship herein granted carries with it all the duties and responsibilities incident to such citizenship.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
